main_difference: Closest ensemble concept: probabilistic linear pool for trading/grid scheduling versus DOEF deterministic DayWeek-LightGBM point blend for building peak shaving with a discrete Validation grid.
Closest model-selection application: meta-classifier chooses models across 300 PV-building instances; DOEF directly chooses per-building convex weight by Validation regret.
Closest accuracy-value diagnosis for building storage; DOEF turns the insight into ensemble selection and a frozen benchmark.
Dual-axis model/ensemble evaluation for industrial BESS economics; DOEF explicitly selects weight by Validation peak-shaving regret.
Peak-specific forecasting for battery control; DOEF forecasts the full curve and selects an ensemble by optimizer-derived regret.
Probabilistic forecast plus stochastic optimization; DOEF uses deterministic point forecasts and deterministic daily dispatch.
Operational cost enters load-forecast training; DOEF leaves base training frozen and uses downstream metrics only for selection.
Decision-focused price forecasting for ESS arbitrage; DOEF targets building load/peak shaving and is not end-to-end.
PV-battery DFL across 20 buildings; DOEF is a simpler non-differentiable-selection approach using load forecasts.
